title: Security & Compliance for Data Centers

seo.title: Security & Compliance for Data Centers
seo.description: • Data center security spans two very different disciplines — physical security architecture and facility cybersecurity — and most compliance frameworks expect both to work together • This course covers physical security design (access control, surveillance, perimeter), facility cybersecurity fundamentals, and the regulatory frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI-DSS) that shape audit requirements • You'll build a security roadmap and facility-specific security policy using the audit framework development, compliance policy templates, and vendor evaluation strategies covered throughout the course — not generic advice, but the actual deliverables an auditor expects to see • The course also covers incident response planning and business continuity for security events, so your program covers detection and response, not just prevention • 8-hour IACET-accredited online course with interactive knowledge checks and final exam; Printable certificate of completion (valid 1 year)

keyDetails.value: Industry Standard – SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / PCI DSS / HIPAA / NIST SP 800-53

title: Tier Infrastructure Fundamentals

seo.title: Tier Infrastructure Fundamentals
seo.description: • The TIER classification system (I through IV) is the industry's shorthand for facility reliability — but understanding what actually separates a TIER III facility from a TIER IV one takes more than reading a definitions page • This course breaks down the topology requirements, electrical redundancy, cooling architecture, and management systems behind each TIER level • You'll learn the assessment methodologies used to audit an existing facility against TIER benchmarks, including gap analysis procedures and infrastructure scoring methods — the same frameworks used before a formal certification engagement, without the certification requirement or cost • This is practical benchmarking knowledge: understand where your facility sits today, what it would take to move up a TIER level, and how to communicate that gap to stakeholders • 8-hour IACET-accredited online course with interactive knowledge checks and final exam; Printable certificate of completion (no expiration)

keyDetails.label: Citation
keyDetails.value: Industry Standard – Uptime Institute Tier Classification (I-IV) / ANSI/TIA-942 Rated 1-4
